title: Darkness retreat study testing for spikes in natural DMT

plain: The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore says he and New Nordics, a group he works with in Florida, are paying for a 2025 study of darkness retreats, where people spend days in total darkness, to see whether the brain's own DMT goes up. DMT is a powerful psychedelic drug that can cause vivid visions. Gallimore tells Michels about the study as one of its funders, and a rise in DMT could help explain the visions people report in the dark.
